svg.title: Same syndrome. Different logical class.
svg.desc: Actual selected simulated shot75. All three parity checks pass; standard logical0 fails while correlated and hybrid logical1 match truth. A closed odd-logical graph cycle preserves detector parity. Not a quality estimate.
